verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs say a project can be treated like any other software project, using version control, code review and CI/CD. Its pipelines and plugins are defined declaratively in project files (the `plugins` property), so automations are config-as-code that can be versioned and reviewed through standard tooling. Rollback is not documented, and versioning and review rely on external git and CI/CD rather than built-in product features. Missing for 10: documented rollback mechanism, built-in version history or diff/review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: you can treat it like any other software development project and benefit from DataOps best practices such as version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
Your project's plugins ... are defined under the plugins property, inside an array named after the plugin type (e.g. extractors, loaders).
